name: Remote viewing (Octopus, CCW chirp)
summary: Circumcerebral counter-clockwise rotation with the chirp signal (Murphy: the best of three signals for psi). Coil-to-coil dwell 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20 ms: each 5-min phase slower than the last, 30 min total as in the single 30-min Ingo Swann exposure. Follow with a blinded trial in the Experiment tab.
source: Murphy, Psychic Skills lecture https://youtu.be/tmC1174POpA?t=1187 , ?t=2732 , ?t=2749 ; Persinger et al. 2002, Percept Mot Skills 94:927
